Resell Data Plans on Shopify: Your Next Big Revenue Stream Awaits

The world is becoming increasingly interconnected. By 2025, it’s projected that there will be approximately 75.44 billion IoT devices globally, encompassing everything from smartwatches and home sensors to industrial machinery .

If you’re a Shopify store owner, particularly one selling connected devices, you’re sitting on a potential goldmine: the ability to resell data plans on Shopify . The explosion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, from wearables like smartwatches to smart home sensors and fleet management tools, has created an unprecedented demand for seamless, integrated connectivity. Consumers and businesses alike are no longer just buying devices; they’re seeking complete solutions.

Imagine offering your customers not just your innovative product, but also the data plan it needs to function, all in one convenient purchase from your Shopify store. This is where the concept of “ Connectivity as a Service ” (CaaS) comes into play, and it’s simpler than you think.

This guide will walk you through how to tap into this burgeoning market, enhance your product offerings, and create lucrative recurring revenue streams by reselling internet and IoT data plans directly from your e-commerce platform.
Why Resell Internet/Data Plans on Shopify? More Than Just an Add-On
Integrating data plan sales into your Shopify store isn’t just about adding another product to your catalog; it’s a strategic move that can significantly benefit your business in multiple ways:

Unlock New Recurring Revenue Streams Unlike one-off product sales, data plans are typically subscription-based. This means a steady, predictable flow of recurring revenue, boosting your bottom line and business stability. Companies like Angel Watch have successfully used this model to create recurring revenue. Enhance Your Product Offerings & Value Proposition For businesses selling connected devices (e.g., kids’ smartwatches, pet trackers, IoT sensors, security cameras), bundling connectivity is a game-changer. It provides a complete, out-of-the-box solution for your customers, making your products more attractive and user-friendly. No more telling customers to “ go find a SIM card and plan ” – you provide it all. Increase Customer Loyalty and Lifetime Value By offering a branded mobile service and a seamless connectivity experience, you deepen your relationship with your customers. They see you as a one-stop-shop for their needs, fostering loyalty and increasing the chances of repeat business and higher lifetime value. Tap into Unmet Market Demand Traditional mobile operators often offer rigid, expensive plans that don’t fit the specific needs of many connected devices (e.g., low data requirements for smartwatches or specialized IoT data plans for industrial sensors). As a reseller, you can offer tailored wireless plans e-commerce customers are actively seeking, catering to niche markets that larger players overlook. For instance, some devices may only need a few megabytes a month, while others require substantial high-bandwidth data globally. Competitive Differentiation In a crowded marketplace, offering integrated data plans can set your store apart. It demonstrates innovation and a customer-centric approach.
The Hurdles of Traditional Data Plan Resale
The idea of telecommunications resale might sound daunting, and traditionally, it was. Businesses faced significant barriers:

Challenge Traditional Approach Complex Operator Negotiations Lengthy, difficult contract negotiations with multiple Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), often requiring hefty commitments. Infrastructure & Billing Overheads Significant investment in billing systems, customer support infrastructure, and technical expertise. Managing Diverse Plans & Pricing Difficulty in sourcing, managing, and pricing a variety of plans to suit different device needs and geographies. Regulatory & Compliance Burdens Navigating complex telecom regulations in different regions. Lack of Flexibility & Customization MNOs often provide one-size-fits-all plans, unsuitable for specialized or low-usage devices. Inventory Management Handling physical SIM card inventory and distribution.

However, the landscape has shifted dramatically with the advent of “Connectivity as a Service” ( CaaS ) platforms and Mobile Virtual Network Enablers ( MVNEs ). These platforms act as an abstraction layer, simplifying the complexities and empowering businesses of all sizes to become connectivity providers.

This is precisely where a solution like Spenza comes in, transforming a once-complex venture into a streamlined, manageable process, enabling you to sell mobile plans Shopify customers can easily access.
How Spenza Empowers Shopify Stores to Seamlessly Resell Data Plans
Spenza is an operator-neutral connectivity enablement platform designed to help businesses procure, manage, and resell wireless services.

It essentially acts as your “ Stripe for connectivity “, providing the tools and infrastructure you need without the traditional headaches. Here’s how Spenza makes reselling Shopify data plans a reality
1. MVNO Enablement Solution

Spenza’s Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) enablement solution empowers businesses to effectively become mobile operators by reselling eSIM plans through a white-label app or, crucially for e-commerce, their existing web store. This means you can offer eSIM Shopify integration.
2. Curated Marketplace of Mobile Plans

Forget negotiating with individual MNOs. Spenza provides access to a curated marketplace of customizable mobile plans from leading operators and IoT platforms worldwide (including AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Vodafone, Aeris, etc.).
This allows you to select and offer a diverse range of plans, from low-bandwidth options perfect for wearables to high-bandwidth plans for data-intensive IoT applications.
3. Seamless Shopify Integration

This is key for e-commerce businesses. Spenza offers direct Shopify integration, allowing you to manage subscriptions and handle payments with no developer resources needed. As highlighted in the Angel Watch case study, “ Vendors can bundle and resell mobile plans via their Shopify store, streamlining onboarding. ” Spenza even provides a Shopify app to make reselling effortless in minutes.
4. Active Spend Management & Cost Optimization

Spenza’s platform isn’t just about selling; it’s about smart management. It allows you to track carrier costs across multiple pools and optimize usage. Features like active plan assignment mean you and your customers pay for actual usage rather than being locked into oversized, preset operator plans.
Spenza uses APIs to monitor usage and intelligently adjust plans mid-cycle to ensure users are on the most optimal plan, potentially saving up to 30% on wireless costs.
5. White-Label Experience for a Branded Mobile Service

Maintain your brand identity throughout the customer journey. Spenza enables you to deliver a branded mobile service , offering cellular service under your brand, “just like an MVNO .” This reinforces brand loyalty and customer trust.
Want to stay ahead of the curve? Check out our latest insights on the future of mobile virtual networks in our MVNO Trends 2025 blog .
6. Simplified Management & Operations

Spenza offers a “ single pane of glass ” for managing services and wireless spend. This includes single contract procurement, unified connectivity, and billing, even if you’re sourcing plans from multiple operators.
The platform handles complexities like parent-child billing, hierarchical account management, and inventory tracking of SIMs, devices, and services.
7. Support for Diverse Connectivity Needs

Whether it’s IoT data plans , eSIMs for global travelers, or standard mobile plans, Spenza’s platform is versatile. It supports various devices including wearables, IoT sensors, smartphones, travel SIMs, 5G routers, and MiFi devices.
The platform offers multi-operator SIMs/eSIMs, which are game-changers for IoT connectivity, allowing configurable preferred network order.
Step-by-Step: Launching Your Data Plan Resale on Shopify with Spenza
Ready to turn your Shopify store into a connectivity hub? Here’s a simplified step-by-step guide to reselling data plans using a platform like Spenza
Step 1: Partner with Spenza

Reach out to Spenza and sign up for their platform. Discuss your specific needs, target audience, and the types of devices you sell or intend to support. Understand their “ Connectivity as a Service ” model and how their MVNO enablement solution can be tailored to your business.
Step 2: Curate Your Data Plan Offerings

Explore Spenza’s curated marketplace featuring mobile plans from a multitude of MNOs, MVNOs, and IoT platforms. Select plans that best suit your target customers and the devices they use. Consider data amounts (low for simple IoT, high for streaming/routers), coverage (local, national, international roaming), and contract lengths.
Spenza allows customization, so you can create plans that aren’t available off-the-shelf from major carriers.
Step 3: Integrate with Your Shopify Store
Leverage Spenza’s pre-built Shopify integration or app. This will connect your chosen data plans to your Shopify product listings.
Ensure a seamless user experience where customers can easily add a data plan when purchasing a connected device or buy a standalone plan. The “ no developer resources needed ” aspect is a huge plus.
For step-by-step instructions, please refer to the guide : How to Launch an MVNO with the Spenza Platform .
Step 4: Define Your Pricing, Markups, and Margins

Set your resale prices for the data plans. Spenza’s platform facilitates setting markups if you’re working within a reseller or Managed Service Provider (MSP) model. Determine competitive yet profitable pricing. Consider offering bundled discounts (device + plan) to incentivize sales.
Step 5: Streamline Customer Onboarding & Subscription Management

Utilize Spenza’s tools for customer onboarding. This includes activating plans, managing eSIM distribution, and handling ongoing subscription management Shopify customers expect. Spenza’s platform is designed to handle user subscriptions, collect payments globally, and manage the lifecycle of services.
Step 6: Monitor, Analyze, and Optimize

Use Spenza’s dashboard and active spend management tools to track plan usage, revenues, and costs. Analyze data to understand which plans are most popular, identify trends in data consumption, and optimize your offerings and costs over time. Spenza’s ability to intelligently adjust plans mid-cycle can be a significant cost-saver.
Proven Success – The IMZ Case Study

IMZ is a U.S.-based technology company offering a comprehensive suite of services, including web hosting, dedicated servers, VPS solutions, and mobile connectivity plans. With a global presence, IMZ provides dedicated servers in 75 locations worldwide, ensuring local routing and same-day delivery for its clients. Their offerings are designed to be both easy and affordable, catering to a diverse clientele seeking reliable hosting and connectivity solutions.
IMZ aimed to expand its service portfolio by introducing a nationwide wireless offering. However, they faced several challenges:

Faced lengthy carrier negotiations (T-Mobile, Verizon). Lacked billing infrastructure for subscriptions and reseller commissions. Required support for both physical SIMs and eSIMs. Wanted a fully white-labeled experience for customers and resellers.
Spenza’s Solution

Instant Network Access : Provided IMZ with turnkey connectivity on T-Mobile and Verizon, eliminating contract delays. Prepaid Billing & Smart Plan Switching : Handled all billing; automatically moved customers to the most cost-effective unlimited plan based on usage. White-Label Portal & Shopify Integration : Delivered a branded portal that embedded into IMZ’s Shopify store, allowing customers to buy and activate plans without leaving the site. SIM & eSIM Support : Enabled easy provisioning of physical SIM cards and eSIM profiles for any device. Reseller Management : Offered a dashboard for IMZ’s resellers to order, track inventory, and receive automated commission payouts.
Impact & Success

Rapid Launch : IMZ’s wireless offering went live within weeks, under its own brand. Revenue Growth : The new wireless services opened up additional revenue streams, contributing to IMZ’s financial growth. Reduced Overhead : Automated billing and plan optimization cut manual finance work by 30%. Scalable Reseller Network : Onboarded 25 resellers quickly, each managing orders and commissions through Spenza’s portal. Improved Customer Experience : Simplified purchase flow and activation process, reducing support tickets by 20%.
Spenza platform allowed IMZ to add a profitable, scalable wireless offering without building telecom infrastructure or handling complex carrier agreements.
The Compelling Benefits of Using Spenza for Shopify Resellers

Rapid Time-to-Market : Launch your data plan resale business in days, not months, thanks to Spenza’s pre-built integrations and ready marketplace. No Heavy Lifting (Infrastructure/Contracts) : Let Spenza handle telecom infrastructure and MNO contract negotiations, freeing you from complexity. Automated Billing & Subscription Management : Benefit from streamlined billing, parent–child billing for resellers, and comprehensive subscription lifecycle management. Highly Customizable Plans : Offer everything from low-bandwidth smartwatch plans to high-bandwidth global IoT plans through Spenza’s flexible options. Significant Recurring Revenue Potential : Build a sustainable, recurring revenue stream that complements your existing product sales. Global Reach, Localized Offering : Source and manage data plans for multiple countries from a single platform while tailoring solutions to local markets. Focus on Your Core Business : With Spenza managing connectivity complexities, you can concentrate on product innovation, marketing, and customer service. Enhanced Customer Experience : Deliver a complete, branded solution that simplifies the customer journey and boosts satisfaction.
Conclusion: Unlock New Dimensions of Growth on Shopify

The demand for integrated connectivity isn’t just a trend; it’s the future. For Shopify store owners, especially those in the connected device space, the opportunity to resell data plans on Shopify represents a significant avenue for growth, differentiation, and enhanced customer value.

The old barriers to entry in the telecommunications resale market have been dismantled by innovative “ Connectivity as a Service ” platforms. By partnering with a provider like Spenza, you can seamlessly integrate wireless plans e-commerce offerings into your store, create new recurring revenue, and provide your customers with the complete solutions they crave. You don’t need to become a telecom expert; you just need the right platform to empower your ambition.

blocks.text: Launch Your MVNO in Days with Shopify and Spenza

Launching an MVNO no longer requires months of telecom integrations or building complex billing systems from scratch. By combining Shopify with the Spenza MVNE platform , businesses can launch, sell, activate, and manage branded mobile services through a modern e-commerce storefront in days rather than months.

Shopify handles the customer-facing experience, including storefronts, checkout, and payments, while Spenza provides the telecom backend for mobile plans, eSIM provisioning, billing, subscription management, and carrier integrations. Together, they simplify the entire MVNO launch process without requiring deep telecom expertise.

In this guide, you’ll learn how Shopify and Spenza work together, the key components of a successful MVNO launch, and a practical step-by-step framework to go live quickly with a scalable mobile business.
What Is a Shopify MVNO?

A Shopify MVNO is a mobile virtual network operator that uses Shopify as its e-commerce storefront while relying on an MVNE platform such as Spenza for telecom operations, including mobile plan management, eSIM provisioning, billing, subscription lifecycle management, and carrier integrations. This combination enables businesses to launch and operate branded mobile services with significantly lower complexity and faster time to market.
What is an MVNO

A Mobile Virtual Network Operator ( MVNO ) is a company that provides mobile services to its customers but doesn’t own the underlying wireless network infrastructure. Instead, MVNOs lease network access from established Mobile Network Operators ( MNOs ), allowing them to focus on niche markets, branding, customer service, and innovative offerings.
The Traditional Challenge: Complexity and high barriers to entry in the telecom market.

Historically, launching a mobile service involved navigating complex negotiations with MNOs, heavy investment in billing and operational systems, and long development cycles. This complexity effectively shut out many innovative businesses and entrepreneurs.
The Modern Solution: Simplifying MVNO launch with innovative platforms.

Today, the landscape has changed dramatically. Modern platforms, particularly Mobile Virtual Network Enablers ( MVNEs ), provide the technology, operator relationships, and support systems needed to get an MVNO off the ground quickly and efficiently.
Sneak Peek: How Spenza and Shopify are democratizing the telecom landscape for businesses like yours.

This is where the powerful combination of Spenza and Shopify comes into play. Spenza provides a comprehensive “ Connectivity as a Service ” platform, acting as your MVNE partner. Shopify offers a world-class e-commerce backbone. Together, they create a streamlined path for you to launch MVNO using Shopify , empowering you to offer branded mobile experiences and tap into the growing connectivity market with unprecedented speed and ease.
Understanding the MVNO Business Model: A World of Opportunity
Key advantages of starting an MVNO:

Recurring Revenue Streams: Mobile subscriptions provide a consistent and predictable income. Angel Watch , for example, aimed to boost subscriptions and create recurring revenue through their MVNO. Enhanced Brand Building: Offering your own branded mobile service strengthens your brand identity and customer recall. Spenza enables device vendors to deliver branded cellular service just like an MVNO. Increased Customer Loyalty: Bundling connectivity with your existing products or services creates a stickier customer relationship and reduces churn. Niche Market Focus: MVNOs can cater to specific customer segments with tailored plans and services that larger MNOs might overlook. Spenza helps target companies with specialty connectivity needs. Control Over Customer Experience: Manage the end-to-end customer journey, from sales to support.
Want to stay ahead of the curve? Check out our latest insights on the future of mobile virtual networks in our MVNO Trends 2025 blog .
Core components of a successful MVNO business model:

Sourcing wholesale airtime from MNOs/Partnering with MVNEs. Defining and pricing mobile plans. Subscriber acquisition and onboarding. Billing and payment processing. Customer service and support. Compliance with telecom regulations.
Spenza’s platform is designed to simplify or automate many of these components.
Why Shopify for Your MVNO? The E-commerce Powerhouse Meets Telecom Innovation

Shopify has revolutionized e-commerce, making it easy for anyone to set up an online store. Now, it’s doing the same for telecom when paired with an enabler like Spenza. Using Shopify as your telecom e-commerce platform offers significant advantages.
Benefits of using Shopify as your telecom e-commerce platform:

Effortless Store Setup and Intuitive Management: Shopify is renowned for its user-friendly interface. You don’t need to be a tech wizard to build and manage your MVNO’s online presence. Integrated Payment Gateways for Global Transactions: Shopify supports numerous payment gateways, allowing you to accept payments from customers worldwide. Spenza also facilitates collecting subscriptions payments globally. Powerful Marketing and Sales Tools: Shopify comes with built-in marketing tools and integrates with a vast ecosystem of apps to help you promote your MVNO and reach your target audience. Scalability: As your MVNO grows, Shopify can scale with you, handling increased traffic and transaction volumes.
Spenza’s direct Shopify integration: A game-changer for rapid deployment.
Spenza recognizes the value of Shopify and has designed its platform to integrate seamlessly with it. Spenza offers a dedicated app available on the Shopify App Store .

For instance, Spenza enabled Angel Watch to bundle and resell mobile plans via their Shopify store, streamlining onboarding. This integration means you can manage subscriptions and handle payments with Shopify, often with no developer resources needed. This direct link is key to how you can launch MVNO using Shopify in days.
For step-by-step instructions, please refer to the guide: How to Launch an MVNO with the Spenza Platform .
Introducing Spenza: Your All-in-One MVNE Partner

Choosing the right MVNE is crucial for your success. Spenza stands out as a comprehensive solution designed for agility and growth. It offers procure-to-pay SaaS with an integrated marketplace of operator mobile plans for managing wireless spend and automating operations.
Think of Spenza as the engine that powers your MVNO, handling the complex telecom backend while you focus on your brand and customers

Spenza aims to empower enterprises to access ubiquitous and seamless connectivity aligned with business and end-user goals. It simplifies cellular connectivity for modern devices, from wearables to IoT devices, by offering a modern SaaS abstraction layer for managing wireless spend.

Spenza seamlessly integrates with any e-commerce platform, including Shopify , through powerful API connections . This flexibility allows you to connect your existing storefront with Spenza’s features effortlessly, enabling streamlined operations, real-time data sync, and enhanced customer experiences—without disrupting your current setup.

Curated Global Marketplace Access a wide array of customizable mobile plans from leading MNOs, MVNOs, and IoT platforms worldwide. This allows you to source plans from Spenza’s marketplace without needing direct contracts with multiple operators initially. White-Label Solutions Deliver fully branded mobile experiences. Spenza enables businesses to resell eSIM plans via a white-label app or web store. They also offer white-label Telecom-as-a-Service platforms for MSPs and channel partners. Comprehensive Subscription Management & Billing Automate the entire lifecycle from activation to payment. Manage hierarchical reseller and enterprise accounts with billing. Spenza WEM (Wireless Expense Management) automates procure-to-pay workflows, helping businesses save up to 30% on wireless costs. It enables enterprises to pay only for what they use. API-First Architecture Built for scalability and custom integrations, Spenza features a multi-tenant, cloud-hosted, API-first architecture. Bring Your Own Network For businesses that already have wholesale contracts with MNOs, Spenza allows them to integrate these into the platform, offering maximum flexibility. Single Pane of Glass Manage all your services, users, devices, SIMs/eSIMS, subscriptions, and wireless spend from a unified dashboard.
